domain-information: A Couple submits a wedding vision brief to outline their preferred style and budget for the event.
A Couple approves the final event schedule to confirm the timing of key moments throughout the wedding day.
A Wedding Planner receives the wedding vision brief and lays out an event schedule.
A Wedding Planner creates a vendor shortlist to help the couple choose suitable venues, florists, and caterers.
A Wedding Planner coordinates vendor bookings to secure availability for the wedding date.
A Wedding Planner orchestrates the meal service and bouquet delivery to the venue Manager.
A Venue Manager receives the booking and determines the availability of the venue.
A Venue Manager confirms venue availability to the planner before the event to ensure all spaces are clean and prepared.
A Florist assembles floral arrangements to match the theme selected by the couple.
A Florist delivers the bouquets and centerpieces on-site before guests arrive.
A Catering Manager prepares a final menu order to ensure ingredient quantities meet the confirmed guest count.
A Catering Manager supervises meal service during the reception to maintain timing and food quality.
